description: Scan a COMP subtree for every external file dependency (movie/image file pars, fonts, LUTs, externaltox links) and report each referenced file, the node+parameter that references it, and whether the file currently exists on disk. The TouchDesigner scan is read-only and copies/rewrites nothing in the network; when out_manifest is set, this tool writes that local JSON path and may overwrite an existing manifest. File-par detection uses par.style ('File'/'Folder') when readable, falling back to a suffix/exact name heuristic (*file*, *fontfile*, *lut*, *externaltox*, *moviefile*, *imagefile*) — both UNVERIFIED across TD builds; `style_supported` records whether par.style was available.

include_missing_only.description: When true, only report assets whose referenced file does not exist on disk.

out_manifest.description: Optional filesystem path to write the JSON asset manifest to. Empty string means do not write a file — just return the inventory.

parent_path.description: Root of the COMP subtree to scan recursively for external file dependencies.

name: collect_project_assets

assets.description: Every external file dependency found in the subtree (after include_missing_only).

exists.description: Whether the file currently exists on disk.

kind.description: How the par was detected: par.style ('File'/'Folder') or the name heuristic that matched.

node.description: Full path of the operator that references the file.

par.description: Parameter name holding the file reference.

manifest_path.description: Path the JSON manifest was written to, when out_manifest was set.

missing_count.description: How many reported assets are missing from disk.

parent.description: Echoed root path that was scanned.

style_supported.description: Whether par.style was readable in this TD build (UNVERIFIED attr). When false, only the name heuristic was used.

warnings.description: Per-op / per-par problems encountered while scanning (fail-forward).

title: Collect project assets
